_comment: Steam library artwork for the MKWMP shortcut, picked by hand on 2026-11-20 from SteamGridDB (game 5483943, 'Mario Kart World', verified). Only links are stored: the installer downloads them on the player's machine at install time. If a link is gone, the installer falls back to SteamGridDB's public search (POST https://www.steamgriddb.com/api/public/search/main/games, no key) and picks the first asset that is not nsfw/humor/epilepsy/animated, language en or none, official style first, upvotes-downvotes as the tie-break; and if that fails too, it installs without artwork.
